"""Reproduce: judge subgraph with llm_client=None + stale judge_result={} in state."""
import asyncio
from src.autopilot.config import PlannerBudgets
from src.autopilot.contracts import PlannerAction
from src.autopilot.graph.agents import JudgeDeps, build_judge

action = PlannerAction(
    control_id="f1",
    intent_id="intent.f1",
    widget_family="textbox",
    value="Ada",
    confidence=0.9,
    required=True,
    source="ai_inferred",
)

async def run_case(name, actions, judge_result_in):
    deps = JudgeDeps(llm_client=None, adapter=None, budgets=PlannerBudgets())
    graph = build_judge(deps)
    state = {
        "actions": actions,
        "parsed_fields": [{"control_id": "f1"}],
        "judge_result": judge_result_in,
        "per_field_verdicts": {},
        "messages": [],
    }
    result = await graph.ainvoke(state)
    jr = result.get("judge_result")
    print(f"[{name}] judge_result = {jr!r}")
    print(f"[{name}] overall_verdict = {(jr or {}).get('overall_verdict')!r}")
    print(f"[{name}] concerns = {len((jr or {}).get('concerns') or [])}")
    print()

async def main():
    # Case 1: real run shape — stale {} from navigation reset, typed actions
    await run_case("typed-actions + stale {}", [action], {})
    # Case 2: dict actions (post-serde) + stale {}
    await run_case("dict-actions + stale {}", [{"control_id": "f1", "source": "ai_inferred", "intent_id": "intent.f1"}], {})
    # Case 3: control — no stale judge_result, typed actions (should match existing tests)
    await run_case("typed-actions + no stale", [action], None)

asyncio.run(main())
EOF
